ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity pixel distribution with a low macro-level ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (dark grey/black) on the fluke surface, estimated at 0.05:1.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark charcoal pigmentation across both visible lobes with diffuse, low-contrast light-grey mottling on the medial sections; high-contrast white focal spots are limited to the periphery (barnacles).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: The central vertex is occluded by water spray; however, the proximal lobe boundaries suggest a wide V-shaped divergence exceeding 70 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations present along the entire visible trailing edge, characterized by jagged peaks and shallow valleys with pixel-amplitudes ranging from approximately 3 to 15 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edges tapering into acute, upward-curving distal tips (lobes).

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast, roughly circular white pixel clusters (barnacle colonizations) densely packed along the leading edges and distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, unaligned high-intensity linear marks (scratches) visible on the right lobe surface and lower left lobe, cutting through the dark primary pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral barnacle colonization and multiple linear rake-like scratches across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant occlusion of the fluke's lower central region and peduncle attachment point by high-velocity water spray and cavitation bubbles.
